name: Kairaku: the broken hearts Elysion
original_name: 壊落 the broken hearts Elysion
source:
In a red and black ballroom someone's heart is broken, tormenting them into madness until they fall apart.

This is the story of a boy and a girl driven wild by madness.
A story painted with a crazy passion as well as a sadness that tears everything apart in its chaos.
A story about standing up against cruel fate.
This is their story.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE042206.html]DLsite English[/url]]
